title: Fucoxanthin Induces Ferroptosis in Cancer Cells via Downregulation of the Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4 Pathway.
authors: Du, Hao-Fei; Wu, Jia-Wei; Zhu, Yu-Shan; Hua, Zheng-Hao; Jin, Si-Zhou; Ji, Jin-Chao; Wang, Cai-Sheng; Qian, Guo-Ying; Jin, Xu-Dong; Ding, Hao-Miao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究岩藻黄素通过Nrf2/HO-1/GPX4通路诱导舌癌细胞铁死亡，分子对接仅用于小分子-蛋白结合验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study investigated the mechanism by which fucoxanthin acts as a novel ferroptosis inducer to inhibit tongue cancer. The MTT assay was used to detect the inhibitory effects of fucoxanthin on SCC-25 human tongue squamous carcinoma cells. The levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS), mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP), glutathione (GSH), superoxide dismutase (SOD), malondialdehyde (MDA), and total iron were measured. Reverse transcription-quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) and Western blotting were used to assess glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4), nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), Keap1, solute carrier family 7 member 11 (SLC7A11), transferrin receptor protein 1 (TFR1), p53, and heme oxygenase 1 (HO-1) expression. Molecular docking was performed to validate interactions. Compared with the control group, the activity of fucoxanthin-treated SCC-25 cells significantly decreased in a dose- and time-dependent manner. The levels of MMP, GSH, and SOD significantly decreased in fucoxanthin-treated SCC-25 cells; the levels of ROS, MDA, and total iron significantly increased. mRNA and protein expression levels of Keap1, GPX4, Nrf2, and HO-1 in fucoxanthin-treated cells were significantly decreased, whereas levels of TFR1 and p53 were significantly increased, in a concentration-dependent manner. Molecular docking analysis revealed that binding free energies of fucoxanthin with p53, SLC7A11, GPX4, Nrf2, Keap1, HO-1, and TFR1 were below -5 kcal/mol, primarily based on active site hydrogen bonding. Our findings suggest that fucoxanthin can induce ferroptosis in SCC-25 cells, highlighting its potential as a treatment for tongue cancer.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了岩藻黄素作为一种新型铁死亡诱导剂抑制舌癌的机制。采用MTT法检测岩藻黄素对人舌鳞状细胞癌细胞SCC-25的抑制作用。测定了活性氧（ROS）、线粒体膜电位（MMP）、谷胱甘肽（GSH）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、丙二醛（MDA）和总铁的水平。使用逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）和Western blotting评估谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）、核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）、Keap1、溶质载体家族7成员11（SLC7A11）、转铁蛋白受体蛋白1（TFR1）、p53和血红素加氧酶1（HO-1）的表达。进行分子对接以验证相互作用。与对照组相比，岩藻黄素处理的SCC-25细胞活性显著降低，且呈剂量和时间依赖性。岩藻黄素处理的SCC-25细胞中MMP、GSH和SOD水平显著降低；ROS、MDA和总铁水平显著升高。岩藻黄素处理的细胞中Keap1、GPX4、Nrf2和HO-1的mRNA和蛋白表达水平显著降低，而TFR1和p53的水平显著升高，且呈浓度依赖性。分子对接分析显示，岩藻黄素与p53、SLC7A11、GPX4、Nrf2、Keap1、HO-1和TFR1的结合自由能均低于-5 kcal/mol，主要基于活性位点的氢键作用。我们的研究结果表明，岩藻黄素可诱导SCC-25细胞发生铁死亡，凸显其作为舌癌治疗药物的潜力。
